canonical.fingerprintAlgorithm: FNV-1a 32-bit over NFKD-normalized lowercase punctuation-stripped ASCII fields; option arrays sorted before option hashing; concept hash combines category, topic and stopword-filtered stem tokens.

officialPyq.layout: 24-byte little-endian records: fileIndex:u8, questionNumber:u16, stemHash:u32, optionsHash:u32, answerHash:u32, topicHash:u32, conceptHash:u32, statusCode:u8

currentNormalizedScan.normalization: NFKD, lowercase, punctuation-insensitive alphanumeric stems; option sets sorted order-insensitively

candidateScan.method: NFKD-normalized stem and order-insensitive option-set checks; token Jaccard screening at 0.34 plus manual topic, concept, reasoning-path and learning-objective review. Candidate pool compared against the 973 pre-existing active questions and all 19 PYQ transcription files (18 official papers plus the 139-record partial duplicate subset); the retained 70 were also checked pairwise within the batch. Post-merge active count is 1,043. Supporting current-affairs, explanation-library, PYQ-transcription-audit and official-source metadata files were also inspected; they contain source notes, explanation mappings or transcription metadata rather than separate question stems/options.
